scripts.build: npm --workspace shared run build && npm --workspace server run build && npm --workspace web run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p shared && tsc --noEmit -p server && tsc --noEmit -p web
scripts.loop:night: mkdir -p .loop && tmux new -d -s cebab-loop 'caffeinate -is node scripts/loop.mjs --merge --until 8 --until 07:00 2>&1 | tee -a .loop/console.log' && echo 'started — follow it with: npm run loop:tail   (stop it with: npm run loop:stop)'
scripts.loop:stop: mkdir -p .loop && touch .loop/HALT && echo 'HALT set — stops at the next stage boundary'
scripts.loop:watch: echo 'read-only: detach with Ctrl-B then D. Ctrl-C cannot reach the run.' && tmux attach -r -t cebab-loop
scripts.loop:recover: git reset --hard && git clean -fd && git checkout main && node scripts/predev-server.mjs && rm -f .loop/HALT && echo recovered
